seo.title: Engineering reliable energy & automation
seo.description: An EPCC company in Bangladesh: gas process plants, compressor stations and metering stations — engineered, procured, built and commissioned by one team, and supported long after handover.

sections.title: Engineered systems, delivered whole
sections.subtitle: EPC, process automation and terminal automation.
paragraphs: EPC packages, control systems and terminal software — designed, built and commissioned by one team.
From gas process plants, compressor stations and metering stations to DCS, SCADA and safety systems, and terminal automation that runs a fuel depot from one screen.

image.alt: Process skids and flare stack at the Titas LOC-E compressor station

sections.title: Partner brands, supported locally
sections.subtitle: Control platforms, valves and instrumentation.
paragraphs: Authorized distribution of control platforms, valves and instrumentation, with spares held in country.
Supcon DCS and safety systems, NexVal and Keckonn valves, Cimarron flare packages, plus Softing, Red Lion and Tancy instrumentation.

sections.title: From first design to year fifteen
sections.subtitle: Engineering, commissioning and lifecycle support.
paragraphs: Engineering before the build, and the support that keeps a plant running after handover.
FEED and automation consulting, installation and commissioning, field and bench calibration, and pipeline leak-detection surveys.

sections.subtitle: Proven delivery on critical infrastructure.
paragraphs: Process plants, compressor stations, city gate and metering stations delivered across Bangladesh.

sections.subtitle: Part of ASX-listed Zicom Group.
paragraphs: A permanent engineering team in Bangladesh — 80+ engineers and technicians across 10 disciplines, held in country.
Zicom Equipment Bangladesh is audited in its own name to ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 by TÜV AUSTRIA.
